title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.31931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table. Weights that belong together share the upper part of their paths, and each decision is inherited by every weight below it, so it is stored once and applied once. This simple change has three consequences. Any trained network can be written as a TWIG, and when the decisions are powers of two its weight layers become circuits made almost entirely of wires and adders, suited to chips whose weights are fixed at fabrication. Pruning, quantization, low-rank factorization, codebooks and weight sharing become edits of one object, so a single optimizer can choose among all of them for a whole network. translated_title: 每个权重都是一条共享离散决策的路径
translated_abstract: 我们提出TWIG（带继承门的树结构权重），这是一种新的表示方法，其中神经网络的每一个权重都是一串微小离散决策的终点：一个符号、一次二的幂次移位、一个零门、一个指向共享表格的索引。属于一组的权重共享其路径的上部，且每个决策被其下方的所有权重继承，因此只需存储一次、应用一次。这一简单的改变带来三个后果。任何训练好的网络都可以写成TWIG形式，且当决策为二的幂次时，其权重层变成几乎完全由导线和加法器构成的电路，适合于权重在制造时即固定不变的芯片。剪枝、量化、低秩分解、码本和权重共享都成为对同一对象的编辑，因此单个优化器即可为整个网络在所有这些方法之间做出选择。而选择这些决策则等价于求解一个高阶玻尔兹曼机的基态问题……
tldr: 该论文提出TWIG树结构权重表示，将神经网络中每个权重表达为共享离散决策路径的终点，从而把剪枝、量化、低秩分解和权重共享统一为对同一对象的编辑，并使权重层可转化为几乎只含导线和加法器的硬件电路。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TWIG, a tree-structured weight representation where every weight is the endpoint of a path of shared discrete decisions, unifying pruning, quantization, low-rank factorization, and weight sharing as edits to a single object, and enabling weight layers to become circuits made almost entirely of wires and adders.
